rationale:
Positives: The agent verified identity using full name + zip to locate a single user, acted only on that account, reviewed orders, and obtained explicit confirmation before attempting any order change and before canceling the order. It handled the inability to remove a single item properly by offering an exchange or full cancellation and completed the cancellation after confirming the reason. 

Issues: The agent stated the refund would go to a specific payment method (Mastercard ending 6081) without confirming the order’s payment history via tools, which is an unsupported assumption. More importantly, when asked for totals paid for grills, the agent claimed there were two grills (including one at $953.39) and summed them to $1,939.05. The tool outputs only substantiated one grill at $985.66 in order #W8668939; no other orders showed a grill. This constitutes fabricated/unsupported information, violating policy. Due to the incorrect final information, the conversation fails the pass bar.
